description: Generates an AI exercise video from a trainer photo (CloneMotion). Use when the user wants to create exercise videos without filming. Needs the target exercise and an image source: trainer_image_url (HTTP URL or data:image/... base64) or trainer_image_id from Workout Defaults; with neither, the first saved trainer image is used. Returns a job ID for get_video_generation_status. Uses 1 AI clip from the monthly limit.

camera_style.description: Look of the clip: "shallow_dof" (soft background), "deep_focus", "portrait_85mm", "wide_14mm", "static_tripod", "rembrandt" (dramatic side light), "golden_hour", "high_key" (bright studio), "noir" (high contrast).

equipment.description: Equipment names. Not used by the current video model, which reads the exercise itself; put guidance in user_requirements.

exercise_description.description: Exercise description. Not used by the current video model, which reads the exercise itself; put guidance in user_requirements.

exercise_id.description: Exercise ID from list_team_exercises. The video shows this movement.

exercise_type.description: Exercise type. Not used by the current video model, which reads the exercise itself; put guidance in user_requirements.

target_muscles.description: Target muscle names. Not used by the current video model, which reads the exercise itself; put guidance in user_requirements.

team_id.description: Not used: this tool works on the signed-in team. Leave it out.

trainer_image_id.description: ID of a saved trainer image (Teams > Workout Defaults > CloneMotion trainer images). Omit both image fields to use the first saved image.

trainer_image_url.description: Trainer photo to animate: an HTTP(S) image URL or a data:image/... base64 URI. Use this or trainer_image_id.

user_requirements.description: Free-text guidance for the AI, up to 2000 characters, e.g. "Low impact, no jumping, knee friendly".

name: generate_video_clip
title: Generate video clip
